'''Twin Suns Two''' was the callsign of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] within [[Twin Suns Squadron]], when the unit was first formed during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|second Battle of Borleias]] at the height of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During the initial stages of the siege of [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces under the command of [[Czulkang Lah]], Horn flew alongside [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] commander and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]. At some point during the same campaign, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]] took over the position. [[Vale (Neimoidian)|Vale]] assumed the position during the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (29 ABY)|raid]] on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. An unknown pilot took the position during the [[Second Battle of Bilbringi]].
